audience: teams that answer customers and send templates on WhatsApp through DoubleTick

useCases.title: Find chats that need an answer
useCases.text: List the chats in the team inbox. Read the messages with one customer.

useCases.title: Check whether a message was read
useCases.text: Read the delivery timeline of a sent message: sent, delivered, read, replied or failed.

useCases.title: Send a WhatsApp text or template
useCases.text: Check the 24-hour window. Then send a text or an approved template after the user confirms the content.

useCases.title: Tag a customer
useCases.text: Add tags and custom field values to one customer. Repeating the call changes nothing.
